venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Upper 80s and sunny, cool air once night fell
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 10/1 (MOD MKZ/JK; upper 80s, sunny).** Net sales $1,061 vs target $1,915 (-44.6%). Food $179. Comps $21.80. 34 guests, check avg $31.20. Nice little start, opener set up the night; lull during traditional dinner time, pickup around 9:30. Switched TV to the Braves playoff game — several guests intently watching. Slowed ~11, everyone out by close. Kitchen: N/A. No incidents. Favorite moment: watching the Braves advance, plus Halloween lights. (Form date field mistyped as 2026-04-03; matched by post time.)

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Warmer tonight, nice; foot traffic slower as folks got last evenings on patios/rooftops
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 10/1 (MOD KK/KE/MD & Chef JMS; warm, nice).** Net sales $1,782 vs target $3,260 (-45.3%). Food $70. Comps $8.45 (0.48%). ~62 guests, check avg $28.74. Slower-paced Thursday; business increased ~8pm with a large post-rehearsal-dinner group (invited back after the wedding). Better weather has people getting last patio evenings in. Smooth service with a few larger groups, dates, friends and industry. Kitchen: lower food sales — few TNF guests, most going to/from dinner. Maintenance: Well 1 soda handle. 86: Orange Wine, N/A Beer, Cider, Taco Tuesday.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: A truly beautiful evening to start October
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 10/1 (AM Chef Josh/Chef Lucas/Maggie S/Evan; PM Chef Lucas & Evan; beautiful).** Net sales incl. events $11,708.32 vs target $10,647 (+10.0%). DC/AM $1,234.52; D&C PM $8,637.31; Garden/6A $1,845.76. Food $2,325.10. No events. Comps $419.32 (~3.58%). 249 guests (Tock), check avg $47.02. Slow start then moving from 7 to close; Applejack Day event in the Garden with DJ Ill Pickle — season change keeping people out of the Garden. Low comps/voids, good sales. Garden/6A had great energy. Kitchen: pretty chill night. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 10/1 (MOD Kyler & Will; warm).** Net sales $6,010 vs target $5,187 (+15.9%). Food $469; beverage $5,541. Comps $175.56 (2.9%). 191 guests (SevenRooms), check avg $31. Thursday near the norm but volume picked up quicker than usual; slow first hour then full — bachelor party, Australians exploring the menu, after-work groups; slow last hour, out by 2. Top sellers: Rosalie, Shinebox, Native Lion, High Plains Drifter. Door: waitlist at 8:30, solid ~10, parties past 12, last sat 1am; investor 4-top; AC unit dripping mistaken for rain. Menu count 18/18. Breakage: collins, DOF, mini ramekin.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 10/1 (MOD Julian & Josh; warm).** Net sales $5,150 vs target $5,187 (-0.7%). Marquee $5,150; Standing Room $0; food $1,157. Comps $176.05. 119 guests, check avg $43.29. Good start, consistent shift; full house (every table and bar seat), waitlist for a while, everyone accommodated; birthdays and lots of first dates. Server trainee Noogan got great feedback. Kitchen: Kevin getting up to speed, ran the kitchen alone. Maintenance: CO2 not carbonating properly. 86: creme de banana, coconut water; low Dirty Sue.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 10/1 (MOD Marcus; warm).** Total net sales incl. events $4,672.61 vs target $4,087 (+14.3%). Marquee bar sales $5,139.89 (reported total); food $773.73. Comps $142.72 (investor 10% $38.72; gift $40; manager $24; rang wrong item $40). 104 guests (65 walk-ins, 39 reservations); check avg $44.93 (net/guests; form reported GCA $48.17 / GA $95.18). No-show revenue $120. Steady night, solid build, biggest pop ~7:45; Sasha in for bartender training; Teleia wrapped barback training. Kitchen: big Thursday — consider raising oyster pricing. Kitchen close not checked. Maintenance: curtains.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Another nice temperate and sunny day
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 10/1 (AM Sam & Lex; PM James & Marcus; sunny).** Net sales $6,947 vs target $6,816 (+1.9%). Municipal AM $3,131, PM $1,899; Sun Club $363; Hot Eye $1,624. Food $2,458. Comps $167. 195 guests (108 AM + 87 PM OpenTable), check avg $35.62. Slow morning (~15 guests before 1pm), decent 1pm from food tours; mild dinner — mostly snacks/drinks before heading to Hot Eye. Hot Eye launched its new menu — smashing success, room filled by 9pm. Sun Club steady, all hotel guests. Kitchen: slow night, inventory; 86 romaine and artisan lettuce. Maintenance: hot air blowing from vents in THE; booth-side speakers stopped working.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: Low 60's, a bit chilly toward end of night
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thursday 10/1 (MOD Curtis Hayes; low 60's, chilly late).** Net sales $11,116 vs target $10,000 (+11.2%). Food $1,443. No events. Comps $820.90 (7.3%) — lots of industry, a couple full comp tabs (Regan and the contractor who did the plumbing for RailSpur and D&C), 1 walk-out tab, full staff shifties, MB/MG comp out. 273 guests, $41.97 avg guest spend. Weird-energy night: First Thursday turnout milder, guests more sauced up leading to table camping and lower drink averages; a few Inkind groups needed damage control (getting onboarded with Inkind so discounts apply); one guest conflict over cologne smoothed over by MOD. Water service felt much better; team getting fluid with bottles. Malachi held the door. Kitchen (Josh, Wes) crushed $1.4k; Andrew Jackson trained. Freezer REPAIRED. No incidents.
